column1: # KEY ORDER, measured rather than argued. Three candidate keys built on identical data:
#   A shipped              platform, country, video_type, content_id, app_version, minute
#   B cardinality-ordered  country, video_type, platform, app_version, minute, content_id
#   C dead column dropped  video_type, platform, app_version, content_id, minute
# Granules read were IDENTICAL for all three on all 8 filter shapes.
# On-disk: A 55.09 KiB, B 75.08 KiB, C 54.84 KiB.
# So the rule-compliant order B buys nothing here and costs 36 percent more disk,
#   because moving content_id (highest cardinality) last breaks compression locality.
# The rule is about granule skipping, and this table has 3 granules. There is almost
#   nothing to skip. The deviation is harmless AT THIS SCALE and is documented as such.
